channels.name: Shamounian (Sam Shamoun)
channels.note: Sam Shamoun's official channel; aggressive Christian polemics against Islam, frequent live debates.

channels.name: Apologetics Roadshow (David Wood)
channels.note: David Wood's channel (ex-Acts17); Christian critique of Islam and Muslim apologists.

channels.name: Christian Prince
channels.note: Arabic-speaking Christian polemicist; long live debates with Muslims on Quran and hadith.

channels.name: Wes Huff
channels.note: Canadian New Testament manuscript scholar; apologetics and textual-reliability debates.

channels.name: InspiringPhilosophy
channels.note: Michael Jones; philosophy, Bible history and responses to Muslim/Jewish/skeptic critiques.

channels.name: Capturing Christianity
channels.note: Cameron Bertuzzi; philosophy-of-religion interviews and debates (posts less often lately).

channels.name: Jay Dyer
channels.note: Eastern Orthodox apologist; debates with Muslims, Protestants, Catholics and atheists.

channels.name: The Counsel of Trent (Trent Horn)
channels.note: Catholic Answers apologist Trent Horn; responses and debates incl. Islam and Judaism topics.

channels.name: Give Me An Answer (Cliffe Knechtle)
channels.note: Cliffe and Stuart Knechtle's campus Q&A, often with Muslim and Jewish students.

channels.name: GodLogic Apologetics
channels.note: Street and online apologetics, heavy focus on Christian-Muslim exchanges.

channels.name: Alpha & Omega Ministries (James White)
channels.note: James White's Reformed ministry; Dividing Line and formal debates with Muslims and others.

channels.name: The Orthodox Muslim
channels.note: The Orthodox Muslim (@MuslimOrthodoxy): Sunni street-dawah and live debates with Christians and critics of Islam, including a live exchange with Jay Dyer.

channels.name: Mohammed Hijab
channels.note: British Muslim debater; Speakers' Corner and formal debates with Christians and atheists.

channels.name: Sapience Institute
channels.note: Islamic apologetics institute (Hamza Tzortzis, Subboor Ahmad and others).

channels.name: Blogging Theology
channels.note: Paul Williams; interviews with scholars on Christian origins, Bible and Islam.

channels.name: The Muslim Lantern
channels.note: Live-stream dawah debates with Christians, Jews and atheists.

channels.name: Smile 2 Jannah
channels.note: Dawah conversations with Christians and others, mostly street and campus.

channels.name: Ali Dawah
channels.note: British dawah channel; Speakers' Corner debates and interfaith discussion.

channels.name: Yaqeen Institute
channels.note: Omar Suleiman's research institute; Islamic apologetics, more lectures than debates.

channels.name: Let the Quran Speak (Shabir Ally)
channels.note: Shabir Ally's show; comparative religion and many recorded debates with Christians.

channels.name: The Muslim Skeptic (Daniel Haqiqatjou)
channels.note: Daniel Haqiqatjou; Islamic polemics against liberalism, Christianity and modernist Muslims.

channels.name: Tovia Singer
channels.note: Rabbi Tovia Singer (Outreach Judaism / Let's Get Biblical); counter-missionary teaching and debates.

channels.name: TeNaK Talk (Tovia Singer)
channels.note: Tovia Singer's call-in show; frequent live exchanges with Christian callers about Jesus.

channels.name: Jews for Judaism
channels.note: Counter-missionary organisation; main outlet for Rabbi Michael Skobac's talks.

channels.name: Modern-Day Debate
channels.note: Neutral host of formal moderated debates, many Christian vs Muslim vs Jewish.

channels.name: whatever
channels.note: Whatever podcast (Brian Atlas); panel shows, recently with frequent religion debates.

channels.name: Premier Unbelievable?
channels.note: Premier's Unbelievable?; moderated Christian-vs-other-worldview dialogues, incl. Islam.
